## Estimating tree height and crown width based on DBH

```{r}
# getting all taxonomic level names for each tree using GBIF
library(rgbif)
```

```{r}
serviced_trees_1 <- serviced_trees[1:5000, ]
serviced_trees_gbif <- name_backbone_checklist(serviced_trees_1$species_scientific)

serviced_trees_2 <- serviced_trees[5001:10000, ]
serviced_trees_gbif1 <- name_backbone_checklist(serviced_trees_gbif_1$species_scientific)

serviced_trees_3 <- serviced_trees[10001:15000, ]
serviced_trees_gbif2 <- name_backbone_checklist(serviced_trees_3$species_scientific)

serviced_trees_4 <- serviced_trees[15001:20000, ]
serviced_trees_gbif3 <- name_backbone_checklist(serviced_trees_4$species_scientific)

serviced_trees_5 <- serviced_trees[20001:25000, ]
serviced_trees_gbif4 <- name_backbone_checklist(serviced_trees_5$species_scientific)

serviced_trees_6 <- serviced_trees[25001:27000, ]
serviced_trees_gbif5 <- name_backbone_checklist(serviced_trees_6$species_scientific)

serviced_trees_7 <- serviced_trees[27001:29000, ]
serviced_trees_gbif6 <- name_backbone_checklist(serviced_trees_7$species_scientific)

serviced_trees_8 <- serviced_trees[29001: 29436, ]
serviced_trees_gbif7 <- name_backbone_checklist(serviced_trees_8$species_scientific)
```

```{r}
# resolving species names with GBIF, which gets us the order, family, and genus of each tree
serviced_trees_gbif <- name_backbone_checklist(serviced_trees$species_scientific)
```

```{r}
# filter down and join with full tree data
serviced_trees_gbif <- serviced_trees_gbif %>%
  select("verbatim_name", "order", "family", "genus")

serviced_trees_gbif <- serviced_trees_gbif %>%
  rename(species_scientific = "verbatim_name")
```

```{r}
write.csv(serviced_trees_gbif, "serviced_trees_gbif.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
# add taxonomy to full serviced trees data
serviced_trees_classifications <- cbind(serviced_trees, serviced_trees_gbif)
serviced_trees_classifications$species_scientific.1 <- NULL
```

```{r}
write.csv(serviced_trees_classifications, "serviced_trees_classifications.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
# calculating the height of each tree
height_eqs <- read_csv("height_equations.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
```

```{r}
# data table for all four types of equations
calc_height <- function(dbh, model, B0, B1, B2) {
  case_when(
    model == "B0 + (DBH * B1) + (DBH^2 * B2)" ~ B0 + (dbh * B1) + (dbh^2 * B2),
    model == "e^(B0 + (ln(DBH) * B1))"        ~ exp(B0 + (log(dbh) * B1)),
    model == "B0 + (DBH * B1)"                ~ B0 + (dbh * B1),
    model == "B0 + (ln(DBH) * B1)"            ~ B0 + (log(dbh) * B1),
    TRUE ~ NA_real_
  )
}
```

```{r}
height_species_eqs <- height_eqs %>% filter(level == "species") %>%
  select(species_scientific = taxon, model, B0, B1, B2)

height_genus_eqs <- height_eqs %>% filter(level == "genus") %>%
  select(genus = taxon, model, B0, B1, B2)

height_family_eqs <- height_eqs %>% filter(level == "family") %>%
  select(family = taxon, model, B0, B1, B2)

height_order_eqs <- height_eqs %>% filter(level == "order") %>%
  select(order = taxon, model, B0, B1, B2)
```

```{r}
trees_matched_height <- trees %>%
  left_join(height_species_eqs, by = "species_scientific") %>%
  left_join(height_genus_eqs, by = "genus", suffix = c("", "_genus")) %>%
  left_join(height_family_eqs, by = "family", suffix = c("", "_family")) %>%
  left_join(height_order_eqs, by = "order", suffix = c("", "_order")) %>%
  mutate(
    model = coalesce(model, model_genus, model_family, model_order),
    B0    = coalesce(B0, B0_genus, B0_family, B0_order),
    B1    = coalesce(B1, B1_genus, B1_family, B1_order),
    B2    = coalesce(B2, B2_genus, B2_family, B2_order)
  ) %>%
  select(-ends_with("_genus"), -ends_with("_family"), -ends_with("_order"))
```

```{r}
trees_with_height <- trees_matched_height %>%
  mutate(height = calc_height(dbh, model, B0, B1, B2))

trees_with_height %>%
  filter(is.na(height)) %>%
  count(species_scientific, genus, family, order, sort = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# calculating the diameter of the crown of each tree
crown_eqs <- read_csv("crown_equations.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
```

```{r}
calc_crown <- function(dbh, model, B0, B1, B2) {
  case_when(
    model == "B0 + (DBH * B1) + (DBH^2 * B2)" ~ B0 + (dbh * B1) + (dbh^2 * B2),
    model == "e^(B0 + (ln(DBH) * B1))"        ~ exp(B0 + (log(dbh) * B1)),
    model == "B0 + (DBH * B1)"                ~ B0 + (dbh * B1),
    model == "B0 + (ln(DBH) * B1)"            ~ B0 + (log(dbh) * B1),
    TRUE ~ NA_real_
  )
}
```

```{r}
crown_species_eqs <- crown_eqs %>% filter(level == "species") %>%
  select(species_scientific = taxon, model, B0, B1, B2)

crown_genus_eqs <- crown_eqs %>% filter(level == "genus") %>%
  select(genus = taxon, model, B0, B1, B2)

crown_family_eqs <- crown_eqs %>% filter(level == "family") %>%
  select(family = taxon, model, B0, B1, B2)

crown_order_eqs <- crown_eqs %>% filter(level == "order") %>%
  select(order = taxon, model, B0, B1, B2)
```

```{r}
trees_matched <- trees %>%
  left_join(crown_species_eqs, by = "species_scientific") %>%
  left_join(crown_genus_eqs, by = "genus", suffix = c("", "_genus")) %>%
  left_join(crown_family_eqs, by = "family", suffix = c("", "_family")) %>%
  left_join(crown_order_eqs, by = "order", suffix = c("", "_order")) %>%
  mutate(
    model = coalesce(model, model_genus, model_family, model_order),
    B0    = coalesce(B0, B0_genus, B0_family, B0_order),
    B1    = coalesce(B1, B1_genus, B1_family, B1_order),
    B2    = coalesce(B2, B2_genus, B2_family, B2_order)
  ) %>%
  select(-ends_with("_genus"), -ends_with("_family"), -ends_with("_order"))
```

```{r}
trees_with_crown <- trees_matched_crown %>%
  mutate(height = calc_height(dbh, model, B0, B1, B2))

trees_with_crown %>%
  filter(is.na(height)) %>%
  count(species_scientific, genus, family, order, sort = TRUE)
```
